title: Hattie the Mouse and the Quest for the Talking Hat
summary: Hattie the mouse is recruited by Seeker the dwarf for a peculiar quest: find a talking hat for his friend Afiska's upcoming journey. Utilizing magic potions and tiny airplanes, the pair travels to the Land of the Clouds. After consulting a flying millipede, they venture into a massive thunder cloud where they encounter Graw, a giant white bird. Graw introduces them to Floofers—flying jellyfish-like beings that enjoy resting on heads to act as talking hats. Hattie successfully befriends a Floofer named Fershika, completing the quest and returning to the workshop with a new talking companion for Afiska.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And he said, "I seek you out, Hattie the Mouse, because I have a quest for you. I would like you to find for me a hat that can talk. And there are no such hats here in the forest. transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Uh-huh.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: "Well, come with me then and I will show you my closet full of potions." transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: But inside one of his special magic workshops was a closet with many shelves, and on each shelf were many little bottles of different sizes and shapes. transcript.text: Now, which one do you choose, Hattie?"

transcript.text: Afiska.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Afiska.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: And it is a person too.

transcript.text: Afiska is a person, and she has her own quest that will take her on a long journey. And she will need a hat because it's a journey to someplace cold and rainy, and it- she needs it to talk because she needs someone to keep her company and help her on her quest.

transcript.text: Sounds good.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Now-

transcript.speaker: Izzy

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: So together they flew their airplanes closer to the thundercloud and Seeker said, "Wait, we shouldn't go too close. There's a lot of wind there because it's a storm. Could be dangerous, but maybe there's someone interesting that we could meet." And just at that moment, whoosh, from above and behind them flew past an enormous white bird with great white wings.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: It was even bigger than the airplanes they were flying. And Seeker said, "You there, come help us." And the great, great white bird wheeled around with a squawk, "Rawr, rawr," and flew back down to talk to Hattie and Seeker. And the bird said, "Hello."

transcript.text: "Hi, Graw."

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Say hello to everyone, Floofy the Floofer." And Floofy said, "Um, hi. I'm just, I'm just a hat. Um, but I, I like it here on, on Graw's head. Um-"

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: "And you may stay there and we will find another one."

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: "Oh. Well, I do have... Thank you. That's very nice of you. I do have lots of floofer friends that don't have anyone's hats, anyone's heads to be hats for. We, we live, um, at the top of the thundercloud."

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: "Okay."

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: "So let's..." And Graw said, "Let's all fly up there and find the floofers." And so they flew their airplanes following Graw, the great white bird with his floofy hat, all the way to the top of the thundercloud. And there they saw, spinning around in a big circle, lots of the floofers.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: The floofers were kind of like flying jellyfish. They looked a little bit like tiny clouds themselves, but they had little tendrils hanging down the bottom, tentacles just like jellyfish, but for flying in the air. And all of them were a little bit hat-shaped, but none of them were on anybody's head.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And so what did Hattie do now?

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: She got it. She got it.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: She picked one of the floofers and said, "Excuse me, Floofer, would you like to be a hat for someone?"

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: "Yes."

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: "You would? Would you like to come right onto my head and try it out?" "Yes." And this floofer, what's, what was this floofer's name?

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Floofer Furshika.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Floofer Furshika hopped right onto Hattie's head, and she said, "Oh," Ha- Hattie said, "can I call you Furshika?" And the hat said, "Yes. I love being a hat." And so Seeker and Hattie flew in their airplanes back down away from the storm cloud to where it was safer.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And then Seeker said, "Okay, let's drink our potions to bring us home. Goodbye, Graw. Thank you. Furshika, you can come with us. Just have a sip." And so they all went back to Seeker's workshop. And Seeker said, "Well, thank you for your help, Hattie."

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: It's your friend.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Well, we'll have to tell that part in another Stars in story, because that's the end for now.

characters.name: Hattie the Mouse
characters.description: A nimble, friendly mouse of Possible Street and loyal friend to Izzy and Seeker, this brave artisan is the wife of Dimitar and mistress of the Workshop of Hats—a weathered hollow tree sanctuary on Cornell Street scented with cedar, ink, and peanut butter toast. Clad in her signature red cloak and pointy hat, she is a resourceful hatmaker whose spirit was forged against massive diggers and the rain-slicked Floofer Cloud. Within her paint-stained home, she carefully curates her husband’s library alongside her own hand-painted volumes while confronting a baffling supply mystery; the discovery of curious clover stickers signals a gathering shadow of intrigue she is determined to unravel.

characters.name: Seeker
characters.description: A brave dwarven explorer and mediator, he resides in a glowing castle hub—a multiversal dock for skyships anchored within the skyline of New York City. From this urban sanctum, he conducts silver slime experiments and tends to wandering cats amidst a massive library. Frequently swapping between a red coat and a mystical purple cloak, his braided red beard remains his most eccentric tool, capable of catching small fish. A master of fusion, he combines ancient stone-craft with high-velocity mechanics, utilizing a legendary magic ladder to scale the shifting architecture of the realms. Whether brewing portal potions, harvesting floof-berries in Limbo with gemstone goggles, or aiding Buddy the Mouse, this walnut-loving student of the stars remains the hero who orchestrated the daring rescue of the world.

characters.name: Afiska
characters.description: A person preparing for a long journey to a cold and rainy place who needs a talking hat for company.

characters.name: The Millipede
characters.description: A resident of the Land of the Clouds who directs Hattie and Seeker toward the thunder cloud.

characters.name: Graw
characters.description: An enormous white bird with great wings who lives in the Land of the Clouds.

characters.name: Floofy
characters.description: A talking 'Floofer' creature who serves as a hat for Graw the bird.

characters.name: Floofer Fershika
characters.description: A jellyfish-like flying creature from the top of the thunder cloud who loves being a hat.

places.name: Hattie's Workshop
places.description: The home base for Hattie the mouse.

places.name: Seeker's House
places.description: Perched at the edge of a mountain, this warm stone sanctuary—Seeker’s original residence and whimsical home shared with Uncle Crisco—has evolved from a secret vault into the purring, chaotic heart of a massive feline gala. Within its well-lit halls where Muppets gather for snacks and scientific discussions, lies a special hidden closet where Seeker brews an enchanted collection of potions that shimmer in every imaginable color.

places.name: Planet of the Mookers
places.description: An enigmatic alien world defined by its fuzzy yet curiously slimy surface, this planet serves as the ancestral cradle of the Mookers and the site of Chicky’s destined path. Strewn with the colossal remains of giant fossils, the realm was recently scouted by Seeker and Buddy and documented in the Seeker’s potion closet; it remains accessible only to those who imbibe a specific purple alchemical elixir.

places.name: Sparkling Silver Desert
places.description: A destination reachable via Seeker's silvery potion.

places.name: Land of the Clouds
places.description: A bright, blue sky world filled with fluffy clouds and flying creatures.

places.name: The Thunder Cloud
places.description: A stormy area within the cloud land, home to Graw and the Floofers.
